thread:
liam: Heads-up — quick post-RFC follow-up on the telemetry-driven adaptive retry window prototype I sketched.

maya: Nice. Is this the one that adapts retry budgets based on percentiles of upstream tail latency? :thinking:

liam: Yep. Idea: use streaming/edge telemetry (stream stalls, early aborts, KV cache hit rates) to expand/contract the per-tenant retry window in realtime. Not global; per-tenant and per-route.

raj: How do you avoid weird interactions with prefix/KV cache? If we expand retries we might replay with stale KV state.

liam: Good call. Plan is to tag retries with an idempotency token and a resume-token header. If upstream reports 'partial' + resume token, subsequent retries include X-Resume-Token and we reconverge state.

sophia: Example header? And how do we surface in metrics?

liam: Example header block:

`````
X-Resume-Token: tkn_v1:tenant=acme;route=/chat;offset=1024;kvcache=hit
X-Idempotency-Tag: retry-v2-<uuid>
`````

Metrics: emit `edge.retry_window.seconds` (current window), `edge.retry_attempts.{success|delayed|dropped}`, and `edge.resumed_partial.count` with tags tenant/route.

maya: What about backpressure -- if we increase retry window, upstream queuing might starve other tenants.

raj: We should couple adaptive window with admission control: if tenant is bursty and causing queue depth > X, we clamp retry window and enable soft-fallback to smaller model/edge.

liam: Agreed. Implementation plan:
1) small runtime module (request-lifecycle/telemetry-adapter) that subscribes to per-route histograms
2) controller that outputs per-tenant policy (window, clamp threshold)
3) edge checks policy at ingress, applies tag and maybe short-circuits to fallback

sophia: Can we make the telemetry adapter passive (read-only) first? Avoid control plane loops.

liam: Yes — start passive signals, then opt-in per-tenant for control. No global default change until validated.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: branch=feat/telemetry-adaptive-retry ts=4145678920 :rocket:

maya: let's add a short-lived experiment flag so we can quickly disable if we see queue pressure spike.

liam: Will add `edge.retry.experimental.disable` runtime flag and a per-tenant override.

raj: Also add a cheap local guard: only allow window expansion if server-side cache hit rate > 60% for last 5min. That reduces stale KV risk.

sophia: Sounds good. I'll stub metrics dashboards and a smoke test that simulates partial-resume flow.

liam: Thanks — I'll open a quick RFC follow-up doc and mark owners. Will ping for review when draft is up. :thumbsup:
